title: Chapter 427
content:
Chapter 427

On the top of Shenxing Peak, Venerable Shenyun is leading a group of elders to stand in midair on the cloud, facing the powerful Yuguo who is also standing in midair on the opposite side.

"What do you mean by this? A mere secular dynasty dares to offend me." Venerable Shenyun said with anger on his face. He was extremely indignant at the offense of the person opposite him, and he wished he could raise his sword and kill him. To vent the hatred in my heart.

"What are you doing, of course it is to suppress the rebellion." Cao Cao sneered.

"Rebellious, when did we become rebellious? My God Star Dao dignified Immortal sect has a good fortune to follow, when will it be your turn for a small secular dynasty to be convicted. When it comes to guilt, I haven't held you accountable yet It is the crime of killing my junior Taoist Qingyun." Venerable Shenyun was full of indignation.

"Daoist Qingyun, you are talking about that sloppy Taoist priest, and you are right. This demon was killed by our imperial kingdom. Qingyun demon performed demon methods in the imperial capital to confuse the people, disrupt order, and violated the law. His Majesty the Emperor Personally decree that he be executed at Caishikou, and hang the dog's blood on the beam for ten days to show the public, as a warning to others." Cao Cao said slowly.

"Damn it, how dare you do this. You will be cut off by the sword today, and then go to settle accounts with that stupid king. You are just a rebel, and you dare to deal with me and other disciples of the immortal sect without authorization. I am really impatient." Shen Yun When the law enforcement elder next to the Venerable heard it, he couldn't stand the grumpy man. The long sword was drawn out of the scabbard immediately, and it turned into a flying light according to his intention, and attacked Cao Cao.

Venerable Shen Yun next to the law enforcement elder wanted to say something, but it was too late, he could only watch Feijian stab Cao Cao.

"Hey, you really are a good thief. You have accumulated treason for a long time, and you dare to assassinate the general of the empire in public. It seems that there is nothing wrong with suppressing your rebellion this time." Without panic, he stretched out his big hand. In fact, a rather mighty small sword was spinning continuously in the long heart, and the sword energy was condensed in it.

"Yi Tian Sword, come out." Cao Cao yelled violently, and his long-sacrificed natal sword came out of his palm, facing the flying light and colliding with it.

The Yitian sword and the flying sword of the law enforcement elder kept colliding in the air, transforming into a series of sword formulas, attacking each other with a variety of wonderful and inconceivable moves, which was extremely gorgeous.

Cao Cao's flying sword is obviously aggressive, and when he swings it up and down, he loses his domineering aura, and an irresistible aura emerges, showing the majesty and demeanor of a generation of heroes.

Although the law enforcement elders on the opposite side were equally decisive, their swordsmanship was obviously biased towards dexterity, and the implication was not comparable to Cao Cao's domineering arrogance between heaven and earth, which was essentially at a disadvantage.

The sound of jingling in midair was endless, and the two long swords confronted thousands of moves in an instant, and the sword light brought up was like a shadow in the air, and the surrounding tens of miles were shrouded in sword energy.

Because the speed was extremely fast, those sword qi had just been born, and hundreds of sword qi appeared in the next moment, as if tens of thousands of sword qi appeared in an instant, which was extremely terrifying.

Finally, after competing tens of thousands of moves, Cao Cao crushed the dexterous sword intent of the law enforcement elder with his grandeur. The flying sword of the law enforcement elder was knocked away, and then cut into two pieces by the Yitian sword, completely losing This competition.

The flying sword of the law enforcement elder on the opposite side was broken, and the talisman of life was destroyed. A mouthful of blood spewed out immediately, his face was like gold paper, his breathing became chaotic, and he was obviously seriously injured.

"What?" Venerable Shenyun, who was watching the battle, shrank his eyes, his expression full of disbelief.

It is obviously just a secular dynasty, and it has only risen for a year or two. How can there be such a strong man?

Just as Venerable Shenyun was astonished, Zhong Yu, who was on the opposite side, got impatient and wanted to end this boring competition.

"Now I give you two choices, the God Star Dao. One is to surrender the faction and be included in the empire. The other is to resist to the end and destroy the whole faction. Choose one!" Zhong Yu said coldly.

"Who are you? How dare you speak such wild words. My God Star Dao sect has been established for thousands of years. How can you, a mere mortal lackey, get your hands on it? You want to die." Said angrily.

"Then you choose the second option? The whole army obeys the order and kills me, and not one of the Shenxing Dao thieves will be left behind." Zhong Yu said.

As soon as he finished speaking, the 100,000 troops behind him moved immediately.

Under the command of the general, the 100,000 troops formed one battle formation after another, and connected each other to form a shocking battle formation, slowly killing from the foot of the mountain to the top of the mountain.

And in the midair, the 16 sixth-order powerhouses who came with Zhong Yu this time also moved their bodies one after another, each picked an elder of the God Star Dao, and killed him.

In an instant, the entire Immortal Branch was on fire. The disciples at the lower level were encircled by the army and surrounded by the surroundings. They had no way out and could only fight hard.

The elders at the top were also pinned down by the strong men of the empire, either one-on-one, or one-on-two, and they all got entangled with their opponents and fell into a dogfight.

As for Venerable Shenyun, as the only Earth Immortal powerhouse in Shenxing Dao, who has reached the seventh level of cultivation, the powerhouses under Zhong Yu's command did not look for him, but instead emptied him and left him to Zhong Yu. Deal with it, this is what was originally discussed.

With Zhong Yu, the only seventh-rank powerhouse in the empire, to deal with the only seventh-ranker in Shenxing Dao, soldiers against soldiers, generals against generals, king against king, everyone found their opponent at this moment.

"Well, I admit that I was mistaken before. Your newly rising dynasty is not an ant, but has a certain strength. When you think that with your strength, you can really destroy my God Star Dao Retire now, I don’t have to hold you accountable for your offence, and what happened to Junior Brother Qingyun can also be treated as if it didn’t happen.” Venerable Shenyun was not in a hurry to act, and the strength shown by the secular dynasty in his impression had already been greatly improved. that shocked him.

More than a dozen celestial masters, plus Zhong Yu, who also did not make a move on the opposite side, are very likely to be earth immortals of the same level as him. This kind of power is almost the same as that of Shen Xingdao.

If you really fight to the death, although Venerable Shenyun is confident that with the help of the gate guard formation, he can keep all these enemies, but the loss of his own sect will definitely not be small, at least seven or eight celestial masters The damage will not run away.

He didn't want to see this kind of situation, so Venerable Shenyun thought that he was generous and wanted to let the opposite Zhong Yu out of his way, so as to eliminate the war.

But all of this is just what he took for granted, Zhong Yu didn't say that he should spare his life. This kind of behavior just made Zhong Yu more angry, thinking that he was insulting himself.
